scores.visual_critic_note: Deliberate Paul Tol colorblind palette, marginal box plot, and leader-line callouts show real design intent, but the percentile labels (P25/P50/P75/P90) overlap the subtitle text and the 'Sam Q.' callout is clipped at the right edge — concrete rendering bugs that undercut an otherwise thoughtful chart.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Log scale is correct for log-normal income data, box plot uses proper Tukey fences from actual data, and dots encode identity not magnitude—but the x-domain is hardcoded [14000,550000] rather than data-driven, failing the scaling and shift metamorphic relations.
scores.stress_test_note: Primarily static visualization with tooltip-only interaction using the unified Pointer Events API; force simulation is pre-computed, no brush/zoom/transitions, no cross-view dispatch, and no mouse-touch conflict risk.
scores.cognitive_load_note: 4-color Tol palette, pre-computed swarm (no live animation), and a shared-axis box plot summary keep cognitive load low — only mild tension from the subtitle text colliding with the P25/P50 percentile labels at the top.

proposer: Inlined the `dx` variable in the top earners mapping — it was only used to compute `noteX` and stored on the object. Eliminated 3 lines (221→218) with identical output.
